item.title: Trans-interface engineering for reliable perovskite solar cells with reproducible stability
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 29 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02007-w Trans-interface engineering (TIE) is used to create vertically aligned soft nanolinks across perovskite and charge-transport layers, simultaneously enhancing interfacial reliability and charge transfer. The TIE-enabled perovskite solar cells achieved a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.67% and enhanced operational stability with high reproducibility.
